title: Length bound for a visit code
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$ over Booleans, natural numbers $m,t$, and work-tape index $\tau$, the code for the last time strictly before $t$ at which tape $\tau$'s head occupied its position at time $t$ has length at most $t+2$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
replaced: For every source machine, reference length $m$, time $t$, and tape $\tau$, the optional-time code of the greatest strictly earlier visit has length at most $t + 2$: a present predecessor is strictly below the query time, and absence at time zero is included.
